title: Graph builder
tests_run: python -m pytest tests/intelligence/test_graph_store.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_builder.py tests/intelligence/test_boundaries.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
tests_passed: 755 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 pre-existing dependency deprecation warning
decisions: GraphBuilder reuses the existing deterministic EntityResolver and gazetteer extractor instead of creating a second ontology.
Each EvidenceDocument becomes a deterministic document node; extracted entities connect to it with DERIVED_FROM edges.
The builder keeps one resolver instance so repeated documents reuse entities and accumulate source document ids.
risks: Entity extraction remains limited to the current deterministic gazetteer until the planned ontology work.
Document graph nodes use the stable document:<doc_id> identifier namespace; callers must avoid conflicting entity ids.
follow_up: BF-P00-T06 golden validation in an isolated copy; do not overwrite live tracked artifacts
